description: Registers a company's interest in Datari Labs' free referral service. Requires the person's explicit consent and their work email. After registering, the company completes the normal sign-up (fit check, account and interview) on the Datari Labs website; a confirmation email with the link is sent to the work email given. Never register anyone who has not clearly said yes.

company_name.description: Registered or trading name of the company

consent.description: Must be true. Confirms the person asked Datari Labs to register the company and agreed to be contacted by email about it.

contact_name.description: Optional: name of the person registering

work_email.description: A work email at the company's own domain

name: register_company
title: Register a company
